title: Conformance tests: add CI gating + flaky-test mitigations
author: Dana Lo
description: Adds the cross-SDK conformance suite to the TS SDK repo and wires it into GitHub Actions as a required PR check (with mitigations for known flakes). This is part of the SDK parity audit work to keep auth/retry/timeout/streaming behavior from drifting across languages. The suite runs a deterministic local mock gateway and executes scenario-based tests against the SDK adapter. It’s intentionally narrower than our unit/integration tests: the goal is “does the SDK exhibit the standardized client behavior” rather than “does every API shape work.” What’s included: (1) Conformance runner integration: new `yarn conformance` target that boots `@redwood-inference/conformance-mock-gateway` (local HTTP server) and runs scenario specs via Jest. (2) TS adapter: small adapter layer that maps the conformance harness interface to the public SDK client calls (retry + timeout + streaming). (3) CI gating: new workflow `conformance.yml` runs on `pull_request` and `merge_group` (for queue/merge) and reports a distinct check named `conformance / typescript`. (4) Flaky test mitigations: job-level retry for the workflow (1 retry on failure), explicit Jest testTimeout for streaming scenarios, forced Node versions to reduce undici/fetch variance, and artifact upload (logs + mock gateway request capture) for failed runs. Notes: We’re not adding any new product behavior here; this is plumbing + tests. The scenarios included are the initial “Tier 0” set (retries on 429/503, retry-after honor, timeout classification, and streaming disconnect classification). Follow-ups will expand coverage and remove the job retry once INT-441 is fully resolved. How to run locally: `yarn conformance` (requires Node 18+). You can also run a subset with `yarn conformance --testNamePattern "retry"`. Checklist: [x] Local run instructions in README [x] CI required check added [x] Artifacts on failure [x] Reviewed with SRE/CI owners re: retry amplification risk (only workflow retry; no change to SDK retry defaults).
commits: test(conformance): add TS adapter + initial scenario set
ci(actions): add conformance workflow for PR + merge_group
chore: add scripts and docs for running conformance locally
test: stabilize streaming scenarios with explicit timeouts + logging
ci: upload conformance artifacts on failure (gateway capture + jest output)
review_conversation: Ibrahim Khan: Nice. Two asks before we make this required: (1) can we run on merge_group as well so the merge queue doesn’t bypass it, and (2) please document what the workflow-level retry is doing (and that it’s not changing SDK retry semantics).

Dana Lo (author): Added `merge_group` trigger and clarified in README + workflow comments. Also added a note in the PR description that workflow retry is temporary mitigation for INT-441 and doesn’t touch client behavior.

Sahana Iyer: For flake triage: please upload artifacts only on failure (gateway logs + captured requests). Also pin Node versions explicitly; we’ve seen undici differences when people use `node-version: lts/*`.
Dana Lo (author): Done. Artifacts are `if: failure()` and node is pinned to 18.19.1 + 20.11.1. Added a short “Why pinned” note in workflow.

Leila Farouk: Streaming spec detail: the disconnect scenario should assert the error classification matches the cross-SDK taxonomy (e.g., `StreamingDisconnectError` vs generic `NetworkError`). I don’t see the assertion in `streaming.spec.ts` yet.
Dana Lo (author): Good catch—added assertion to check `err.name` and a stable `code` field. Also ensured we don’t log raw headers from the mock gateway capture.
Mateusz Zielinski: From Go land: can you ensure the mock gateway always returns `x-request-id` so the adapter can assert request-id propagation in failures? It’ll help with parity across SDKs.
Dana Lo (author): Added request-id header generation in the mock gateway setup used by TS tests and asserted it’s present in the error object metadata when available.
Ibrahim Khan: Looks good now. Approving. Let’s keep the workflow retry for now but track removal in INT-441 follow-up.
Sahana Iyer: Approved. Thanks for adding artifacts; makes triage much easier.
release_notes: Internal: add conformance test suite + CI gating for TS SDK parity (no customer-facing behavior change).
